attchmntText: EIH Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: EIH Limited submitted a presentation to investors and analysts regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue from operations of 694 crore rupees, EBITDA of 225 crore rupees, and PAT of 141 crore rupees for Q2 FY27. Standalone figures showed revenue from operations of 622 crore rupees, EBITDA of 204 crore rupees, and PAT of 117 crore rupees. The presentation highlighted a RevPAR growth of 13 to 15 percent year-on-year. Management outlined an expansion strategy involving 32 new properties scheduled to be operational by 2031. The company also noted that domestic air traffic contracted by approximately 6 percent year-on-year in Q2 FY27.

attchmntText: Lasa Supergenerics Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Lasa Supergenerics Limited reported a net loss of 183.89 lakh rupees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved these unaudited financial results on November 14, 2026. Revenue from operations stood at 1.24 lakh rupees. The company faces severe operational disruptions due to an uninsured fire incident at its Ratnagiri factory on May 18, 2025. This event caused a total production halt and resulted in an exceptional loss of 2,057.47 lakh rupees. The statutory auditors have expressed a modified opinion on the financial statements. Management has indicated a going concern risk, citing inability to commence manufacturing and pending statutory clearances. The company is exploring contract manufacturing or leasing options. Additionally, the company is contesting GST demands aggregating 3,810.93 lakh rupees. Bank balances of 5.71 lakh rupees and fixed deposits of 26.42 lakh rupees remain in dormant status.

attchmntText: Lasa Supergenerics Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Lasa Supergenerics Limited reported a net loss of 183.89 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and 2,737.12 lakhs for the half year. Revenue from operations was 1.24 lakhs for the quarter. The statutory auditor issued a modified opinion. The company cites a fire incident on May 18, 2025, at its Ratnagiri factory as the primary cause of operational disruption. This event resulted in an uninsured loss of 2,057.47 lakhs recognized as an exceptional item. Management states it is unable to commence manufacturing due to operational constraints and pending statutory clearances. The company is exploring contract manufacturing or leasing options. GST demands aggregating 3,810.93 lakhs are being contested. Bank balances of 5.71 lakhs and fixed deposits of 26.42 lakhs are in dormant status.

attchmntText: TIL Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 16, 2026, titled "PRESS RELEASE".
voiceSummary: TIL Limited reported Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue of 198 Cr, a 143% year-on-year increase, with consolidated EBITDA rising 433% to 17.37 Cr. Standalone operating revenue reached 101 Cr, up 29% year-on-year. The company recorded its first cash profit in five quarters, narrowing the net loss to 1.71 Cr. Consolidated order book stands at 534 Cr, comprising 391 Cr in prime products and 143 Cr in aftermarket. TCPL, consolidated from 8th May 2026, contributed 92 Cr in standalone revenue. H1 FY27 consolidated revenue totaled 315 Cr. The company delivered 20 ReachStackers and secured a large-value defence maintenance contract. Foreign exchange movements and logistics costs impacted the bottom line. TIL expects sustained growth in H2 FY27 driven by order book conversion and TCPL contributions.

attchmntText: Supreme Infrastructure India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a revised press release dated November 16, 2026, titled " Supreme Infrastructure reported Q2FY26 Revenue . ".
voiceSummary: Supreme Infrastructure India Limited submitted a press release titled Supreme Infra’s Q2 Marks a Strong Financial Revival to BSE and NSE on November 16, 2026. The media release highlights the company's financial performance for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations increased 114.8% year-on-year to 2,900.42 lakh rupees. Total income rose 130.3% to 3,356.27 lakh rupees. The company reported a profit after tax of 367.79 lakh rupees, marking its first profitable quarter post-Scheme. Finance costs declined 94.7% quarter-on-quarter to 313.06 lakh rupees. The Composite Scheme was completed on October 31, 2026, resolving legacy debt issues. The company is now debt-free with positive net worth. Auditors have discontinued the going concern emphasis. More than 4 crore rupees were recovered from old debtors during the quarter.

attchmntText: Brightcom Group Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates

Brightcom Defence plans to establish a demonstration facility in the United States. The presentation contains forward-looking statements subject to risks and uncertainties.

attchmntText: Hinduja Global Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 16, 2026, titled "Rackspace Technology selects HGS to expand global engineering and digital capabilities.".
voiceSummary: Hinduja Global Solutions Limited announced a strategic three-year partnership with Rackspace Technology on November 16, 2026. The collaboration aims to expand global engineering and digital capabilities. HGS will provide dedicated teams in India for site reliability, cloud, data, and security engineering. Services include enterprise technology services, digital engineering, cloud modernization, product engineering, and sales enablement. A specialized migration engineering practice will focus on infrastructure modernization. HGS resources will also contribute to Rackspace's AI platform roadmap through software development and quality engineering. The partnership strengthens HGS's position in high-value Global Capability Center operations. It aligns with the company's expansion into digital engineering and AI-enabled operations. HGS reported total income of Rs. 4,857.0 crore for the year ended March 31, 2026.

attchmntText: Investor Presentation on the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Magellanic Cloud Limited submitted an investor presentation regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors reviewed and approved these results on November 13, 2026, subject to limited review by Statutory Auditors. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, total revenue rose 29.4% year on year to Rs. 21,452.45 lakh. EBITDA increased 3.3% year on year to Rs. 5,565.23 lakh. Profit after tax was Rs. 2,659.93 lakh. Diluted earnings per share stood at Rs. 0.45. IT-Surveillance revenue grew 79.3% year on year to Rs. 5,632.65 lakh. IT and ITES Services revenue rose 17.2% year on year to Rs. 15,618.02 lakh. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, total revenue grew 20.1% to Rs. 39,657.56 lakh. Total equity as of September 30, 2026, was Rs. 73,871.97 lakh. Total assets reached Rs. 1,33,802.97 lakh.
